android.desc:
The thunderstorm sounds are effective as a sleep ambience to help you beat insomnia and promote good sleep. If you are looking for heavy rain sounds for sleep or rain noise for sleeping that features amazing thunderstorm sounds, then this rain noise application is for you.

This app features thunderstorm sounds that will put you to a peaceful state anytime you want. These raining sounds will free you from tension and will take you to a state of calmness and tranquility.

The relaxing rain sounds for sleeping can improve your mood and reduce the time taken to fall asleep, they may help induce relaxation for people who have trouble winding down for bed. Rainstorm sounds are a natural remedy for anxiety and stress and are effective to drown out any distraction noises from outside.

You can use this rainy mood maker to play rain sleep sounds, make ambience for your yoga practice and meditation. The rain sounds are completely natural, calming and soothing for the ears and mind. 

Prepare yourself for a truly unique experience! Find yourself in the middle of a rainstorm, exercise control over thunders and bolts of lightning, set a timer and let the rainfall wash away your stress.

There is a great variety of sounds like rainforest sounds, rainstorm sounds, rainy day and more to help you enjoy your rainy mood. These sounds can be played with different types of peaceful soothing sounds such as rain on tin roof, rain on tent, rain on window and more.


CAN HELP YOU TO:
★ Aid insomnia
★ Tinnitus calming and masking
★ Ease anxiety and stress

SPECIAL FEATURES:
★ High-quality thunderstorm sounds
★ Rainscapes with flexible volumes
★ Adjustable rainfall and thunder intensities
★ Exceptional rain noise for sleep, that create an ambience to block distracting noises
★ Realistic illumination effects, suitable for visual thunder simulation in darker environments
★ Fade-out timer system
★ Background play while using other apps
